newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges lower in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges lower in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed down by 0.26 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 503.69 points from 505.02 on Monday.
Total volume was 1.40 million dinars against 732,645 dinars at the previous session.
Le Moteur firm fell 2.96 dinars to 27.04 dinars with only 40 shares changing hands. Le Moteur which trades in agricultural equipment had announced lower profits for 1996 compared to 1995.

Banque de Tunisie slid 1.02 dinar to 76.94 dinars. Arab Tunisian Bank was down 0.98 dinar to 32.02. ATB had announced it was distributing a 0.65 dinar dividend per share of a nominal price of five dinars on its profits for 1996.
Placement de Tunisie declined 0.4 dinar to 13.3 dinars. Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing was down 0.3 dinar to 32.7. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel edged lower 0.3 dinar to 13 dinars.
Airline Tunis Air was up 0.5 dinar to 23.5 dinars. Banque du Sud rose 0.3 dinar to 26.39. BTEI bank advanced 0.18 dinar to 23.18 dinars. ($1= 1.08 dinar)
